steps.title: Aspirate custom volume
steps.instruction: Using the p20 single‑channel pipette, aspirate the specified volume (2–10 µL) from the source well indicated in the uploaded CSV file; source wells are located in up to ten pieces of 24‑well, 96‑well, or 384‑well labware on the OT‑2 deck.

steps.title: Dispense to destination well
steps.instruction: Dispense the aspirated volume into the destination well indicated in the CSV file; destination wells are in one of the ten loaded labware pieces on the OT‑2 deck.
